# 04. Name and brand

**Goal:** a name with an available domain and a brand kit ready for Expo and the stores.
**Gate:** domain checked; kit generated by script; contrast measured; icon tested at small sizes.

## Name

1. Shortlist (5 to 10). Criteria: easy to say and spell, no accents in the domain, does not
   describe just one niche if you plan to grow.
2. Domain: public RDAP lookup (404 = available).
   ```bash
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://rdap.registro.br/domain/<name>.com.br
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://rdap.verisign.com/com/v1/domain/<name>.com
   ```
3. Search Play and the App Store for the exact name.
4. Trademark registration (INPI in Brazil) is **your responsibility**. Until then, the name is provisional.
5. **Package** (`br.com.<app>.app`) is immutable after the first publication: record it as D##.

## Brand: explore with images, finish with code

| Phase | How | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Exploration | 3 to 4 concepts, each on a board: symbol, wordmark lockup, icon, one-color version, reversed version, 48 and 24 px | Compare entire concepts, not isolated logos |
| Choice | Show buyers (5 people from the audience) | The audience chose a concept the owner would not have recommended |
| Refinement and kit | SVG generated by script (Python or Node) | Exact geometry, variations in one pass, editable file; image generator got the same concept wrong 2 times |

Without an image generator (Claude-only mode): Claude draws geometric concepts directly in SVG,
or you bring concepts from an external generator and Claude recreates the chosen one as vectors.

### Phrase that avoids rework in the logo prompt

Include on every concept board: **"plain light background, no blur, no glow, no vignette, no
torn edges"**. Without it, words such as "app icon" and "check" pulled in a dark, blurry style
in two different apps. If a concept comes out wrong 2 times, rewrite the concept instead of
insisting on corrections.

## Final kit (generated by the same script)

- Symbol and wordmark lockup (text converted to outlines, OFL-licensed font).
- One-color and reversed versions.
- Android adaptive icon: foreground, background and monochrome, artwork inside the safe zone
  (66 dp out of 108).
- 512×512 store icon and 1024×1024 iOS icon without transparency.
- Favicon and sharing image for the site.
- `BRAND.md`: clear space, minimum size, what not to do.

## Brand tests

- **24 px** next to common system icons: one of our symbols could be read as "download".
- **Manufacturer masks**: circle, squircle, teardrop, rounded square.
- **Contrast** of brand color against the background (`tools/contrast.py`). Bright orange with
  white text measured 2.8:1 and failed; the solution without changing the brand was dark text in
  the dark theme and a deeper shade of the color as "primary" in the light theme.
- **Competitors**: download icons from the top 20 in the store category and make a side-by-side
  sheet. A web search agent reads text, cannot see icons; the sheet solves this in 1 minute.

## Logo on screens

The image generator **never** gets the logo right. Generate the screen, erase the logo area and
paste the official wordmark lockup by script. Fix reference screens too, or the error spreads
to later generations.
